tickerText: [TENNIS] Wimbledon 2026 Sunday, July 13: Jannik Sinner successfully defends his title with a 6-7(7), 7-6(2), 6-3, 6-4 win over Alexander Zverev in 3hr 46min — the world No. 1 rallied from a set down after a third-set slip unsettled Zverev, extending his head-to-head lead to 10-0 and claiming his fifth Grand Slam trophy • Linda Noskova's historic all-Czech women's final win over Karolina Muchova on Saturday capped a dramatic fortnight at the All England Club • [SQUASH] Six Indian players reached the quarterfinals at the HCL Squash PSA Challenger Tour in Chennai on July 12, led by second seed Suraj Chand — the tour next heads to Tasmania for the Eastside Open in Hobart, July 22–26, with PSA Satellite registration closing July 17 • [BADMINTON] The DAIHATSU Japan Open Super 750 opens Tuesday July 14 at Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium with a $950,000 purse — top seed Shi Yuqi leads the men's draw, Soh Wooi Yik and Man Wei Chong debut their new Malaysian men's doubles partnership, and Leong Jun Hao faces Taiwan's Chi Yu-jen in a 3-3 head-to-head opener • [PICKLEBALL] The PPA Australia 250 Melbourne runs July 15–19 at Raya Pickleball Club, followed by the Macon PPA Challenger July 17–19 and the inaugural Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Open in Singapore July 23–26 with 658 players entered and weekend championship-court tickets sold out • [TABLE TENNIS] Mongolia hosts its first ITTF world-ranking events July 14–23 with the WTT Youth Contender and WTT Feeder drawing 300-plus athletes from 30 countries, while WTT Star Contender São José dos Campos 2026 runs July 21–26 in Brazil featuring Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi

newsItems.title: Sinner Defends Wimbledon Crown With Fifth Grand Slam Title
newsItems.excerpt: Jannik Sinner rallied from a set down to beat Alexander Zverev 6-7(7), 7-6(2), 6-3, 6-4 in Sunday's Wimbledon men's final, successfully defending his title in 3 hours 46 minutes. The world No. 1 extended his winning streak over Zverev to 10 matches and claimed the fifth Grand Slam trophy of his career after a third-set slip shifted momentum on Centre Court.

newsItems.title: Six Indians Reach Quarterfinals at Chennai PSA Challenger
newsItems.excerpt: Six Indian players advanced to the quarterfinals at the HCL Squash PSA Challenger Tour in Chennai on July 12, including second seed Suraj Chand, who rallied past Kuwait's Ammar Altamimi 6-11, 11-5, 11-5, 11-6. Om Semwal, Rathika Seelan, Sanya Vats, Unnati Tripathi and Pooja Arthi Raghu also reached the last eight.

newsItems.title: Japan Open Super 750 Set to Begin in Tokyo on Tuesday
newsItems.excerpt: The DAIHATSU Japan Open opens July 14 at Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium with a $950,000 purse. Top seed Shi Yuqi heads the men's draw, while Soh Wooi Yik and Man Wei Chong debut their new Malaysian men's doubles partnership. Leong Jun Hao opens against Taiwan's Chi Yu-jen in men's singles with their head-to-head tied at 3-3.

newsItems.title: PPA Australia 250 Melbourne Opens Ahead of Singapore Asia 500
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Australia 250 Melbourne runs July 15–19 at Raya Pickleball Club, kicking off a busy stretch that includes the Macon PPA Challenger July 17–19 and the inaugural Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Open in Singapore July 23–26. The Singapore event has 658 players entered with weekend championship-court tickets sold out.
